text: DBIM HOME: THE PERSONAS ARE THE LIVE SITE'S. Explore User Personas showed For Government Officials and For Researchers, drawn with the reference build's clip-art (an IT professional and a researcher). It now shows what dosje.gov.in shows, in its order — For Government Officials, then For Beneficiaries — with the Department's own two drawings, copied byte-identical (268 px, 61 KB and 51 KB). For Students and For Researchers keep their persona pages. The handoff file's persona slide carries the new Government Official drawing.
